title: kit.widgets-plugin.v1
description: The declarative part of an archetype plugin of the widget engine. A plugin module's default export is this object plus its hooks (needs, derive, render, check; optional resolve and exports.<kind>); the registry validates both and refuses what the contract does not name. Plugins hold no content: every text comes from the project's widgets.spec.json (docs/WIDGETS.md).

contract.description: The plugin contract's major version this plugin was written for.

id.description: The archetype id the spec names. The kit's plugins have bare ids; a project's own start with its prefix (its registered prefix from the project registry).

describes.description: One sentence for the docs and the check's messages: what the archetype shows and what it needs.

reads.description: The shared scenario fields the plugin reads (actors, steps, inputs, outcomes, compare, screens, …): documentation the check keeps honest.

spec.description: The scenario key the plugin owns and the JSON Schema 2020-12 fragment for it, composed into kit.widgets-spec.v1 by $ref. `shared: true` means the key already belongs to the shared scenario model.

schema.description: A JSON Schema 2020-12 object; local $defs are the plugin's own, #/$defs/{id,tone,text,sourced,value} are the shared ones.

requiresWidget.description: A scenario holding this key must also ask for a widget of this archetype.

data.description: A JSON Schema 2020-12 for the derived widget data (validated by kit widgets check).

rtl.description: Works in right-to-left locales (mirrors, logical properties).

reducedMotion.description: Shows its final state statically under prefers-reduced-motion.

needsCanvas.description: Draws on a Canvas2D layer (the static HTML does not depend on it).

runtime.description: The progressive-enhancement module (an ES module, default export mount(el, api)), a path relative to the plugin file, loaded only when a widget of this archetype is on the page; null for none.

chrome.description: The plugin's interface words per locale (a project plugin; the kit's own live in the locale packs). `title` is the widget heading; en is required.

chromeKeys.description: The interface words the plugin reads from the locale packs (each must exist in en, fa and ar).

textKeys.description: Property names under which the plugin's derived data carries text a visitor reads (kit widgets check proves each is traceable to the spec or a source).

requires.description: Other plugins this one builds on (registered first).

exports.description: Export kinds the archetype can feed (build.exports[].as), each a function (widget, entry, ctx).

exportUsage.description: Where a widget exported as a kind must also be placed (usage.surfaces[].placement), with the message the check gives.

styles.description: A stylesheet template (rendered from the project's tokens like theme/widgets.css), a path relative to the plugin file; null for none.
